Take a look at these example Network Biology dissertation titles for ideas while developing your own research idea!

Methodology & Integration

“Hybrid Approaches in Network Biology: Interfacing Graphlets and Graph Neural Networks for Biological Understanding” Focus: Blending deep learning and traditional methods applied to network-based tasks. 2. “Evaluating and Integrating Embedding and Topology-Based Methods in Network Biology” Focus: Kai, in determining benchmarks between spectral, random-walk, graph neural network embeddings against direct topology approaches. “Marrying Graph-Based Paradigms: A Multi-Method Perspective for Evaluation in Network Biology” Focus: Developing a meta-framework that considers comparison across so many ways of doing something.

Cross-Domain Learning & Transfer

4. “Toward Domain Independent Network Alignment: A Cross-Disciplinary Comparison of Methods” Focus: Method comparison for biological and social networks. 5. “From Molecule to Message: Adapting Social Network Methodology for the Inference of Biological Networks” Focus: Method transfer from social networks to biological networks.

Deep Learning & Graph Representation Learning

6. “Higher Order GNNs for Subgraph Sensitivity in Protein Network Analysis” Focus: Using expressive GNNs to model graphlets and protein structure. 7. “Geometric Deep Learning and Representations of Protein Networks in 3D: Exploring Potentials Beyond Graphs” Focus: The application of geometric deep learning based on protein surface networks that have a 3D structure. 8. “Learning from Structure: Graph Neural Networks Guided by Ontologies for Functional Genomics” Focus: Embedding biology ontologies into GNN models where that reflection is important for downstream applications.

Evaluation, Uncertainty & Interpretability

9. “Evaluating Uncertainty in Graph-Based Biological Predictions: Aleatoric and Epistemic Approaches” Focus: Understanding and lessening uncertainty in network biology models. 10. “Providing Guidance for Evaluating Methods in Network Biology: Towards Robust and Reproducible Community Benchmarks” Focus: Creating community-based benchmarks and/from metrics.

Network of Networks & Multiscale Modeling

11. “Modeling Biological Systems as Networks of Networks: Multiscale Connections Challenges and Perspectives” Focus: Multilayer, multiplex, and hierarchical networks. 12. “Hierarchical Graph Learning in Network Biology: A Graph-of-Graphs Study for Disease Modeling” Focus: Hierarchical architecture for integrating multiple networked systems. If any of these topics sparked an idea, that’s a great place to start!
